route_rationale: The 40 skin cameras reliably measure nearby surfaces, while the prior fridge scene established that they do not observe the grasp target in useful range. The primary endpoint penalizes non-target contact, so a surface-avoidance task tests the modality the hardware actually supplies.

scene.target: grasp-validated Cup_10 (7.0 x 7.3 cm cross-section) sampled independently near x=0.76 m and y in [-0.04, 0.04] m
scene.intrusion: one matte wall-colored overhead panel entering from left or right
scene.target_intrusion_independence: target placement RNG and intrusion-side schedule are independent

gate_a_object_signal.reason: collision route; the frozen target is nearest-surface geometry, not object position

pre_rollout_construction_retries.seed_rule: deterministic retry_seed(row, retry_index) from the frozen manifest row
pre_rollout_construction_retries.eligible_failure_window: task sampling or initial task.reset/expert trajectory construction, before the initial observation is accepted and before any action
pre_rollout_construction_retries.terminal_boundary: the row becomes outcome-bearing immediately after a successful initial reset; no later exception, contact, task failure, or success is eligible for retry
pre_rollout_construction_retries.reporting: all failed construction attempts and seeds are retained in retry_history

surface_observability_guard.definition: Before the first grasp-target contact or closing command, identify depth rays whose sensor-local point transforms inside the active intrusion AABB (1 cm tolerance). A frame is active when at least one such point is in range.

pilot_act_training.source: collision-free successful pilot_train rows only, ordered by frozen role_index
pilot_act_training.split: first 80 percent train, remaining 20 percent validation
pilot_act_training.checkpoint_rule: minimum validation loss across the fixed 2000-epoch run

phase1.adjudication: All applicable guards and Gates B/C must pass simultaneously. Otherwise stop before full collection or policy training.

endpoint.contact_sampling: after every 2 ms control/physics step and at episode boundaries

frontend.route_target: nearest visible surface point in each sensor local frame plus in-range validity
frontend.input: 32 causal 8x8 depth frames per sensor (8 control steps x 4 simulator subframes)
frontend.architecture: weight-shared 819k-class conv-stem transformer, CLS token, sinusoidal positions, 4 layers, 4 heads, d_model=128
frontend.invalid_encoding: zero XYZ and false validity; far-plane sentinels never become regression targets
heldout_metrics: mean Euclidean XYZ error on valid in-range samples

confirmatory_design.power_statement: With 80 observations per arm, a conservative equal-n independent-proportions normal approximation has 80% power at two-sided alpha=0.05 for about a 21.6 percentage-point increase from a 50% ACT baseline. Pairing may improve precision but is not credited in this planning number.

analysis.decision_ci: two-sided 95% percentile interval for each paired risk difference

confirmatory_design.decision_rule: PACT_BENEFIT_ESTABLISHED requires positive PACT-ACT and PACT-PACT_ZERO point differences, both paired-bootstrap 95% lower bounds above zero, and both two-sided Fisher p-values below 0.05. PACT_WORSE_THAN_ACT requires the PACT-ACT paired-bootstrap 95% upper bound below zero and two-sided Fisher p<0.05. A reconciled experiment not meeting either rule is PACT_NO_CONFIRMED_BENEFIT. Any unreconciled scheduled row is PACT_EXPERIMENT_INCOMPLETE.

freeze_rule: Development rows may cause a newly versioned scene before pilot collection. Immediately before the first pilot_train row, regenerate and hash the manifest. From that point onward the scene, gates, endpoint, contact taxonomy, construction-retry rule, training rule, and analysis are immutable.
